name: SING
summary: Sing and it tunes you, sings harmonies and a choir with you, or turns you into a vocoder. Hold REC to loop it; tilt to play the loop faster or backwards. Syncs with a BAND.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Best with headphones or the line out: the board's speaker sits next to the mic.
status_note: Runs on a board: 25-35 % CPU, no dropouts (2026-10-15). Not played much yet.
